segments.text: My name is Joel Walscott.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Thank you for the opportunity to speak today.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I'm an orthopedic surgeon from Meckwan, Wisconsin.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: After high school, I spent almost 14 years in education and training.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I developed a large orthopedic practice focusing primarily on joint replacement.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I average over 5,000 patient visits per year and perform well over 800 surgical procedures per year.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: While my personal core identity focuses on my family, I love my job as an orthopedic surgeon.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: My patients and coworkers will undoubtedly say that I have a passion for my job.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: On December 30th of 2020, I received the first Moderna COVID vaccine without incident initially.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Approximately one week later, I recognized that my feet were numb, a sensation of pins and needles.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I also began having powerful electrical shock sensations down my entire spine radiating to my feet.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Within days, I obtained an MRI of my cervical spine.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: It revealed no acute changes to account for my numbness.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Moved forward three or four days, I was sitting in a clinic room at work talking with a patient.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I attempted just simply to stand from a sitting position.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I couldn't stand.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I pushed myself up with my arms, then quickly fell backwards.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Later that day, I had MRIs of my thoracic and lumbar spine.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I soon saw a neurologist, actually two to three days later, who diagnosed me with transverse myelitis, a rare condition that involves a demyelinated lesion of my thoracic spinal cord.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: While my neurologist recommended I take two or three months off of work, I agreed to take two weeks.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: After I returned, I operated on two consecutive days, although I intended shortened schedule.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: After the second day, I felt horrible.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I was numb from my umbilicus to my feet.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I could barely walk.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And I've really been, I have been off work since.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I'm just not safe to work as an orthopedic surgeon.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: After my diagnosis, I brought up the question of whether my condition could be related to the Moderna COVID vaccine that I received.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I asked my employer to report it to VAERS.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I was aware that the UK AstraZeneca COVID vaccine trial was delayed twice because of three cases of transverse myelitis.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Assuming the FDA and the CDC would be alarmed at my diagnosis, I expected to be contacted soon after my VAERS submission.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: No phone call, no contact.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: In fact, weeks passed.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I then contacted the CDC myself.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: They acknowledged my various submission, but stated my reaction was categorized as not serious, as I had not been hospitalized and I hadn't died.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I have never heard from the CDC again.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: No contact with the NIH, no contact from the FDA.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I notified Moderna directly numerous times and asked that I be contacted.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: No one from Moderna ever contacted me.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: One word describes how I felt in the first few months after my diagnosis, abandoned.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: My life has dramatically changed after this adverse reaction.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: My career of 19 years that I took almost 14 years to train for is likely over.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: While my electrical sensations have decreased, my numbness, weakness, and poor balance are unchanged as compared to January of 2021.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I compare myself now to a car.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I begin
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Each day with a quarter tank of gas, when my fuel tank is empty, I'm done for the day.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: If I overdo it, like today, I plan on spending the next day or two on the couch.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Let me be clear, I am pro-vaccine.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I got one Moderna COVID vaccine.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Let me be clear, I had a real adverse event.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I urge the CDC, the FDA, the NIH, and all other involved governmental agencies to listen to the injured.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Their adverse events are real.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I urge everyone to become open and transparent with COVID vaccine data.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: The virus system is grossly inadequate.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I am bewildered how we as a country seem to be dependent on foreign data.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I urge additional monies be allocated to studying the etiologies and treatment of these adverse events.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I also urge Congress to enact legislation to allow for financial remedy under the Vaccine Injury Compensation Program for those injured by the COVID-19 vaccinations.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Thank you.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
